q: I had two job offers and could not decide. Sadhak Ji read my chart for an hour, explained the dasha I am in and why one role would drain me. Eight months on, I know it was the right call.
Sent photos of both palms on a Sunday and had an eleven-page report by Tuesday. Specific, not the usual vague lines.
Calm, patient, and he never pushed a product. The remedy was a mantra and a daan, nothing to buy.
The tarot session gave me the clarity to finally speak to my parents about my marriage.
We changed the spelling of our shop name on his advice. Footfall has been steady since Diwali.
